title: Crypto’s Push Into Wall Street Suffers Setback After Bill Fails
summary: Crypto’s long march into mainstream finance took a step backward Tuesday when the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act, denying the industry a chance to turn its newfound influence in Washington into fresh rules that could outlast the current administration.

title: Thai Finance Chief Sticks to 2.5% Growth Goal
summary: Thai Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas is sticking with the government’s forecast for 2.5% economic growth this year despite the surge in oil prices. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed Seen Hiking Rates in Defiance of Trump: Decision-Day Guide
summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to lift interest rates on Wednesday for the first time since 2023 as policymakers lose confidence that inflation will cool sufficiently without at least a nudge from the central bank.

title: Asian Stocks to Edge Higher as Traders Await Fed: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian stocks were poised for a modest gain as surging oil prices and rising bond yields kept investors cautious ahead of the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision.
